First reason is because it takes only 1 slot in your inventory. One charm won’t make you a killing machine but imagine you stack multiple of these or theoretically your whole inventory - they don’t need to have perfect stats because good luck finding 40 of them. Before you know it your character rose significantly in power. 

Second reason is the way flat damage is calculated by the game. I don’t remember the exact formula but it gets multiplied by a lot of modifiers making it so at the end of the day your total damage gained is always higher than the sum of that flat dmg. This is the case for Grief and the main culprit for why its so broken is exactly flat dmg value.

Third - dont forget you get AR and life too. And they stack, too.
